No alcohol is completely hangover-proof, but **clear, highly distilled spirits** —such as **vodka, gin, light rum, and blanco tequila** —generally cause milder hangovers than darker drinks. They contain fewer **congeners** (chemical byproducts of fermentation and aging that can worsen hangover symptoms), though total alcohol intake remains the biggest factor.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF16Lp1_voXjQpV-fwmYVNtVUC4oGtf1NtgiZQquLkDSHuwYBTVFNKk0arbas5y2Fz3_LY1sJv2yytmw6PHloOZHr0j-4wIyaCpqTA5gsZJt0Gvwm7pIfEDVSs-U2n9OrykTierriLguQWDxhXfI_sOcINWkxLSAn_uMRei_ATj5SKPXNfOj9fWmAA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF15s64PgS9p7nnuwCVO8OqNQ9JJ8hpNTysmS-OIDjbnchmHLaz92Sluhx8WSDnIiaGB4snNxRH6O4zDsUjepB5nVLDr5Fm7RjHHISgYVX6WiXTTrw9b06z4qpp55T-1qXjSDqwAzvuXRMiE3IJSXtjBavSb2RfhgSctvAbp5vWdECwT_ayoYq71T6i1j9M2nj91Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkpqU_RxoR2bbnaEwQijGhglwJnDa3JTVim8YGtH_rrfSrMkpBsuD6BllzjQvL7D3SaU4v_-nQGiClKfKRZKrpaGWOk9n_q0Zij68RuNWdkZJHPodCP0xklTB-s2ytO9xbN33gjpR6uIDZB-qmD7h)

### Lower-Hangover Options

- **Vodka:** Heavily distilled and filtered, leaving very few congeners.
- **Gin & Light Rum:** Clear spirits with lower congener levels than aged or dark liquors.
- **Tequila Blanco:** Unaged clear tequila; avoid cheap or caramel-colored varieties with added sugars.
- **Dry White Wine & Light Beer:** Often lower in congeners and alcohol/sugar than red wines or dark, aged spirits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkpqU_RxoR2bbnaEwQijGhglwJnDa3JTVim8YGtH_rrfSrMkpBsuD6BllzjQvL7D3SaU4v_-nQGiClKfKRZKrpaGWOk9n_q0Zij68RuNWdkZJHPodCP0xklTB-s2ytO9xbN33gjpR6uIDZB-qmD7h)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF15s64PgS9p7nnuwCVO8OqNQ9JJ8hpNTysmS-OIDjbnchmHLaz92Sluhx8WSDnIiaGB4snNxRH6O4zDsUjepB5nVLDr5Fm7RjHHISgYVX6WiXTTrw9b06z4qpp55T-1qXjSDqwAzvuXRMiE3IJSXtjBavSb2RfhgSctvAbp5vWdECwT_ayoYq71T6i1j9M2nj91Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXFGbq1dLDF1LV_bKODh8gBFQmuDDH9TYsejrVUcA4eDn5zRu9ORNJc_J-eFr0Hs8ErUXRZF_mypm4MRoVsU7TESop_03VDtEQC6DL5wlZiCDdWRgQYSjUnj_EZRG-3FzT)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXp4ItoAqdNK8fmML-mc7QlfOKCBaCHszMs9c1v5ivwobb66zIl0BGS1f5rDfDOScoOdTAPXIHGotN9Y30QHwRgcp1J0rdMstDCcwFI_zXIh2B17smUqXlfcuoRfq6aKmx)

### Higher-Hangover Drinks to Limit

- **Dark, aged spirits:** Brandy, cognac, whiskey, bourbon, and dark rum tend to pack high levels of congeners.
- **Red wine & sugary cocktails:** Tannins, sulfites, congeners, and extra sugar can worsen dehydration and next-day sluggishness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF15s64PgS9p7nnuwCVO8OqNQ9JJ8hpNTysmS-OIDjbnchmHLaz92Sluhx8WSDnIiaGB4snNxRH6O4zDsUjepB5nVLDr5Fm7RjHHISgYVX6WiXTTrw9b06z4qpp55T-1qXjSDqwAzvuXRMiE3IJSXtjBavSb2RfhgSctvAbp5vWdECwT_ayoYq71T6i1j9M2nj91Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXFGbq1dLDF1LV_bKODh8gBFQmuDDH9TYsejrVUcA4eDn5zRu9ORNJc_J-eFr0Hs8ErUXRZF_mypm4MRoVsU7TESop_03VDtEQC6DL5wlZiCDdWRgQYSjUnj_EZRG-3FzT)

On [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF19Ote-zIsKEQHXyIJFeLMPqbkdrk2tYZr5ZP4RUHjnl6UFXlzRj18LoXvhmdJULQ_NUv22Lrynnau0lOJQrt_AAzlvAP63yedbQhZtBr_EMs3YUH787dFYfhYL7oNYT1VAlmk4U1D3ijKo0GOg-hcRtBVItcsxDF9tew3Juewpo5u5CKvAlZ7PSHwPklKF9YGxebmGx_K9jrQG4) , opinions on this topic are mixed: many users favor clear spirits or hard seltzers for lower sugar and fewer congeners, while others report feeling better on beer than on gin, wine, or vodka. ### Quick Habits That Matter Most

- **Pace and limit intake:** No drink prevents a hangover if you drink too much ethanol.
- **Eat first and hydrate:** Have food before drinking, drink water between alcoholic drinks, and skip sugary or energy-drink mixers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXTEiYiG9VU8DwAwC94UIVfqO9p964NdwNW3cyBBWaUp3Uc0eQ-EEm71dhjh3o8MqZcsT_gxKicdeUhPq0EUGZcuoDfTZ_f4PEOfgQBYxaa4QekhLN5RdYlL1WZbmlFFuekA5-JzwQlUzhqYRap_kXgwlmupKF1t4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXkpqU_RxoR2bbnaEwQijGhglwJnDa3JTVim8YGtH_rrfSrMkpBsuD6BllzjQvL7D3SaU4v_-nQGiClKfKRZKrpaGWOk9n_q0Zij68RuNWdkZJHPodCP0xklTB-s2ytO9xbN33gjpR6uIDZB-qmD7h)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF16Lp1_voXjQpV-fwmYVNtVUC4oGtf1NtgiZQquLkDSHuwYBTVFNKk0arbas5y2Fz3_LY1sJv2yytmw6PHloOZHr0j-4wIyaCpqTA5gsZJt0Gvwm7pIfEDVSs-U2n9OrykTierriLguQWDxhXfI_sOcINWkxLSAn_uMRei_ATj5SKPXNfOj9fWmAA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXFGbq1dLDF1LV_bKODh8gBFQmuDDH9TYsejrVUcA4eDn5zRu9ORNJc_J-eFr0Hs8ErUXRZF_mypm4MRoVsU7TESop_03VDtEQC6DL5wlZiCDdWRgQYSjUnj_EZRG-3FzT)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXFCfd-i4j0pfh3dwGOLdK4xG8qpa6cZXOZ-UWs1g_9iU31dv0u05kq8sS7Am-kyDrPm_c_no56iVctOG6JdZm3uaYWyqgg8e3I7gdd_3XBPDvStxubI3c81SrH_VIJa4A)
